user.title: Set up Package Tracker
user.description: Add carrier API credentials and your first tracking number afterwards from this integration's "Configure" button.

add_package.title: Add a package
add_package.description: Paste a tracking number. Leave carrier as auto-detect unless it guesses wrong.

manage_packages.title: Manage tracked packages
manage_packages.description: Select any packages to stop tracking and remove.

carriers.title: Carrier API credentials
carriers.description: All fields are optional. A carrier with credentials configured here is tried first; any configured fallback aggregators below are then tried in order (17track, then AfterShip, then TrackingMore, then Ship24) for that same package if the native call fails or no native credentials are set. Leave everything blank to rely on the fallback aggregators alone.
